comparison.objective: Position, unfold, level, and switch on a foldable desk lamp.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual manipulation of a free base and three passive hinges plus toggle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Base inside its frame, shade at least 20 cm high and within 15 degrees of level, with lamp on.
comparison.reason: This tests articulated-object configuration and final pose, with no fracture, impulse regulation, retained insert protection, or debris recovery.
